About Us: Spike Aerospace is redefining aviation with groundbreaking aircraft designs, including the Spike S-512 Diplomat Supersonic Jet. We are dedicated to reducing flight times, enhancing fuel efficiency, and driving innovation in the aerospace industry. Join our mission to shape the future of air travel.
We are seeking an experienced Aircraft Configuration Engineer to develop and optimize aircraft layouts and configurations for cutting-edge aerospace projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aerospace design and be passionate about creating innovative solutions.

Responsibilities:
  • Develop and manage aircraft configurations, ensuring optimal integration of all systems and components.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including aerodynamics, propulsion, and structures, to create cohesive aircraft designs.
  • Conduct trade studies to evaluate design options and their impact on performance, weight, and manufacturability.
  • Define and document aircraft layout, including interior, structural, and system arrangements.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards for aircraft configuration and design.
  • Utilize CAD tools and software to create detailed configuration models and drawings.
  • Support design reviews, presentations, and project milestones.
  • Continuously refine configurations based on feedback, testing, and emerging technologies.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in aircraft configuration or related aerospace design roles.
  • Strong understanding of aircraft design principles, systems integration, and trade studies.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar software.
  • Familiarity with FAA and EASA regulations and standards.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident due to project requirements.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with supersonic aircraft or advanced aerospace technologies.
  • Knowledge of weight optimization and balance in aircraft design.
  • Familiarity with digital twin or advanced simulation techniques.
Why Spike Aerospace?
  • Work with a forward-thinking team focused on innovation and excellence.
  • Contribute to transformative projects in aviation and aerospace.
  • Flexible work arrangements and a dynamic, collaborative culture.

How to Apply:
Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or portfolio below.

Spike Aerospace, a pioneer in supersonic aviation, is expanding our team with a remote Human Resources Specialist. This role is critical for sourcing and recruiting the engineering talent that drives our innovations. We are looking for a proactive HR professional who excels in recruiting technical talent and can efficiently manage recruitment activities remotely.

Job Description:

As a Human Resources Specialist at Spike Aerospace, you will spearhead the recruitment and initial screening of candidates for engineering roles, ensuring a fit with our high standards and innovative culture. This remote position offers flexibility, requiring a dedicated professional capable of working independently to connect us with the best aerospace engineering talent.

Responsibilities:

  • Candidate Sourcing and Recruitment:
    • Develop targeted strategies to attract skilled engineers, utilizing job boards, social media, and professional networks.
    • Manage job postings and recruitment outreach efforts effectively.
  • Initial Screening and Interviews:
    • Conduct preliminary interviews to evaluate candidates’ qualifications and alignment with role requirements.
    • Collaborate with hiring managers to move forward with promising candidates.
  • Communication and Candidate Management:
    • Act as the primary point of communication for candidates, providing timely responses and updates throughout the recruitment process.
    • Ensure consistent and clear communication with hiring managers regarding candidate status and recruitment needs.
  • Administrative and Compliance:
    • Maintain accurate records of all recruitment activities and candidate interactions.
    • Ensure all recruitment practices comply with applicable employment laws.

Qualifications:

  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Demonstrated experience in HR, with a focus on recruiting technical or engineering staff.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to effectively manage a remote, part-time schedule.
  • Familiarity with HRIS and recruiting software.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field is preferred.

How to Apply:

If you are interested in shaping the future of aerospace engineering by connecting us with exceptional talent, please submit your resume and a detailed cover letter below. Your cover letter should outline your previous experience in technical recruiting, your approach to working remotely, and why you are interested in this role.

Spike Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Join us and play a key role in recruiting the minds that will define the next era of supersonic travel!

Spike Aerospace is at the forefront of transforming air travel with innovative aircraft designs like the Spike S-512 Diplomat Supersonic Jet. Our mission is to reduce flight times, improve fuel efficiency, and deliver sustainable solutions for the aviation industry. Join our pioneering team as we push the boundaries of aircraft performance and design.

We are looking for a Stability and Controls Engineer to lead the development of aircraft stability, control systems, and flight dynamics for our cutting-edge subsonic and supersonic aircraft. This role is ideal for someone with a passion for innovation and a deep understanding of flight control systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and analyze flight control systems, focusing on stability and control characteristics of aircraft.
  • Perform flight dynamics modeling and simulation to ensure optimal performance in various flight conditions.
  • Collaborate with aerodynamics, propulsion, and structural teams to integrate control systems into overall aircraft designs.
  • Design control algorithms and systems to enhance aircraft stability, maneuverability, and handling qualities.
  • Conduct system identification, flight testing, and validation of control system performance.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for aircraft stability and control systems, including FAA and EASA standards.
  • Develop simulation models and conduct simulations for performance evaluation of aircraft control systems.
  • Document findings, designs, and processes in detailed technical reports and presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in flight control systems design and analysis.
  • Must be a US citizen or a permanent resident.
  • Strong understanding of flight dynamics, stability, and control theory.
  • Experience with control systems simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar.
  • Knowledge of aircraft flight testing and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with regulatory standards for flight control systems (FAA, EASA, etc.).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with supersonic aircraft stability and control systems.
  • Familiarity with advanced control algorithms and autonomous flight systems.
  • Hands-on experience with flight control systems testing and validation.

Why Spike Aerospace?

  • Be part of an innovative team leading the future of aviation.
  • Work on exciting, high-impact projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements and a collaborative culture focused on innovation.

How to Apply:
Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples or portfolio below.

At Spike Aerospace, we are shaping the future of aviation with revolutionary aircraft designs, including the Spike S-512 Diplomat Supersonic Jet. We are committed to reducing flight times, improving fuel efficiency, and enhancing sustainability in air travel. Join our team as we work on innovative aircraft projects that will change the way the world flies.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Aircraft Structural Engineer to play a critical role in the design, analysis, and development of cutting-edge aircraft structures. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aircraft structural design, analysis, and optimization.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and analyze aircraft structures, focusing on lightweight, high-strength materials.
  • Perform structural analysis using finite element analysis (FEA) and other tools to ensure the integrity, durability, and safety of aircraft components.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including aerodynamics, propulsion, and avionics, to integrate structural components into the overall aircraft design.
  • Develop and implement innovative structural solutions for subsonic and supersonic aircraft.
  • Ensure structural designs meet all regulatory and safety standards, including FAA, EASA, and military requirements.
  • Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to optimize the fabrication and assembly processes for aircraft structures.
  • Conduct testing and validation of structural designs, including aeroelasticity, static, fatigue, and failure analysis.
  • Document design processes, analysis methods, and results in technical reports and presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in aircraft structural design and analysis.
  • Must be a US citizen or a permanent resident.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis tools, including finite element analysis (FEA) software.
  • Strong understanding of aircraft materials, including composites and advanced alloys.
  • Experience with structural testing and validation.
  • Knowledge of regulatory standards (FAA, EASA) and compliance for aircraft structures.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with supersonic aircraft structural design and analysis.
  • Familiarity with composite materials and advanced manufacturing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with aircraft structural testing and certification processes.

Why Spike Aerospace?

  • Join a forward-thinking team focused on revolutionizing aviation.
  • Work on innovative, high-impact projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements and opportunities for professional growth.

How to Apply:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Propulsion Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be passionate about innovation and possess a strong background in aircraft propulsion systems, particularly in advanced designs and efficiency improvements.

  • Lead the design, analysis, and development of propulsion systems for subsonic and supersonic aircraft.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including aerodynamics, structures, and avionics, to integrate propulsion systems into overall aircraft design.
  • Conduct engine performance testing and optimization using simulation tools and physical models.
  • Research and develop new propulsion technologies with an emphasis on fuel efficiency, emissions reduction, and sustainability.
  • Evaluate and implement advancements in propulsion systems, including hybrid-electric and alternative fuel technologies.
  • Provide technical expertise in propulsion-related regulatory compliance and safety standards.
  • Document findings, processes, and designs in technical reports and presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in aircraft propulsion design and development.
  • Must be a US citizen or a permanent resident.
  • Strong understanding of gas turbine engines, jet propulsion, and thermodynamics.
  • Proficiency in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and other simulation tools.
  • Experience with engine testing and performance analysis.
  • Knowledge of advanced propulsion technologies, including hybrid-electric and sustainable fuel solutions.
  • Familiarity with FAA, EASA, and other regulatory requirements for propulsion systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in supersonic aircraft propulsion systems.

Join the cutting edge of supersonic flight development!

Spike Aerospace is seeking a highly experienced and talented Senior Aerodynamics Engineer to join our team. As a Senior Aerodynamics Engineer, you’ll provide technical leadership and expertise in the development of our next-generation supersonic civilian jet, ensuring that our aircraft meets the highest standards of performance, safety, and efficiency.

Job Description:

As a Senior Aerodynamics Engineer at Spike Aerospace, you’ll be a key member of our engineering leadership team, responsible for overseeing and guiding the aerodynamic design and analysis of our supersonic aircraft. Your technical expertise and leadership will be instrumental in ensuring the successful development of our innovative aircraft.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize empirical methods, lower-order tools, Computational Fluid Dynamics techniques and optimization methods to lead aircraft design and analyze aerodynamic performance.
  • Provide support for wind tunnel testing and contribute to design optimization.
  • Participate in preliminary design tasks, including basic aircraft sizing.
  • Offer technical leadership and guidance to the aircraft design team.
  • Build, mentor, and support a team of engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment.
  • Collaborate with other engineering departments and contribute to various projects as needed.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in aerodynamics and related fields.
  • Suggest innovations to improve the quality and effectiveness of our products.

Requirements:

  • Possess a deep understanding of fixed-wing aerodynamics, propulsion, and performance principles.
  • Have extensive experience with lower-order aerodynamic tools, CFD analysis, airframe aerodynamic design, and optimization methods.
  • Demonstrated experience in conducting aerodynamic analysis of supersonic aircraft.
  • Have experience with wind tunnel testing and analysis.
  • Possess a strong understanding of airplane flight characteristics and performance analysis methods.
  • Have experience with Part 25 certification projects for transport category airplanes.   
  • Be proficient in Python, MATLAB, or FORTRAN programming.
  • Have experience using Star-CCM+, CFD++, Ansys Fluent or FUN3D.
  • Hold a Bachelors or Masters degree in aerospace engineering.
  • Have at least 10 years of engineering experience applying the specified skills.
  • Must be a US Citizen or a permanent resident.

How to Apply:

If you’re a highly experienced and talented Senior Aerodynamics Engineer ready to contribute to the future of supersonic flight, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio (if applicable) below.

Spike Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

Join us in breaking the sound barrier!

Join the cutting edge of supersonic flight development!

Spike Aerospace is seeking a talented and passionate CFD Engineer to join our team. As a CFD Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in the development of our next-generation supersonic civilian jet by using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations to analyze and optimize aerodynamic performance.

Job Description:

As a CFD Engineer at Spike Aerospace, you’ll be a key member of our engineering team, responsible for conducting advanced CFD simulations to understand and improve the aerodynamic behavior of our supersonic aircraft. Your work will directly contribute to the design and development of innovative solutions for challenges related to supersonic flight.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute complex CFD simulations to analyze the aerodynamic performance of various aircraft components, including airframes, wings, control surfaces, and inlets/nozzles.
  • Apply advanced CFD techniques, such as turbulence modeling, grid generation, and solver selection, to accurately predict flow characteristics and aerodynamic loads.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and other team members to interpret simulation results and provide insights into design improvements.
  • Conduct sensitivity studies to evaluate the impact of design changes on aerodynamic performance and identify optimal configurations.
  • Assist in the development and validation of CFD models against experimental data.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in CFD technology and research, continuously improving your skills and knowledge.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on computational fluid dynamics.
  • Must be a US citizen or a permanent resident.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience working as a CFD Engineer in the aerospace industry or a related field.
  • Proven proficiency in CFD software packages (ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, CFD++ FUN3D, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of fluid mechanics principles and aerodynamic theory.
  • Experience with grid generation techniques and meshing tools.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with high-speed flow simulations (supersonic/hypersonic).
  • Knowledge of computational aeroacoustics (CAA) techniques.
  • Experience with parallel computing and high-performance computing (HPC).

How to Apply:

If you’re a talented and passionate CFD Engineer ready to contribute to the future of supersonic flight, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio below.

Spike Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

Join us in breaking the sound barrier!

Join the team shaping the future of supersonic flight!

Spike Aerospace is leading the charge in transforming air travel with the development of a next-generation supersonic civilian jet. We’re searching for a talented and passionate CAD Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll play a vital role in bringing our innovative designs to life, using your expertise to create detailed and accurate 2D and 3D models that will reintroduce supersonic flight.

Job Description:

As a CAD Engineer at Spike Aerospace, you’ll be a key contributor to our design process. You’ll work closely with engineers, designers and other team members to translate concepts into precise technical drawings, ensuring our supersonic jet meets the highest standards of performance and safety.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize advanced CAD software (CATIA, NX etc.) to create and maintain complex 2D and 3D models of aircraft components and assemblies.
  • Develop detailed and accurate technical drawings, including assembly drawings, detail drawings, and part models, following industry standards and established design specifications.
  • Participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and feedback to improve overall functionality and manufacturability.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to interpret engineering concepts and translate them into clear and concise CAD models.
  • Conduct engineering analyses to validate designs and ensure they meet performance and safety requirements.
  • Participate in the creation and maintenance of design documentation, including parts lists, bills of materials, and assembly instructions.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest CAD technologies and best practices, continuously improving your skills and knowledge.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related field.
  • Must be a US citizen or a permanent resident.
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience working as a CAD Engineer with a focus on complex mechanical assemblies.
  • Proven proficiency in advanced CAD software (CATIA, NX, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) principles.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in the aerospace industry.
  • Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software.
  • Experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping techniques.

How to Apply:

If you’re a passionate and detail-oriented CAD Engineer eager to contribute to a revolutionary project, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio below.

Spike Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

Spike Aerospace is leading the charge in transforming air travel with the development of a next generation supersonic civilian jet. Dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation, we are on the lookout for a passionate and creative storyteller to join our team.  This is an exciting opportunity where you will use your storytelling skills to share the benefits, destinations, and exciting opportunities that supersonic flight offers.

 

Job Description:

As a Creative Storytelling Writer at Spike Aerospace, you will be the voice that captivates audiences, creating excitement about the future of faster air travel. Your stories will showcase the numerous benefits, destinations, and life-enriching opportunities that our supersonic flight promises.

Responsibilities:

  1. Conceptualize and Develop Compelling Stories:
    • Generate imaginative and engaging stories that highlight the benefits of faster air travel, from reduced travel time to unlocking new possibilities.
    • Convey the thrill and excitement of supersonic flight through captivating storytelling.
  2. Explore Unique Destinations:
    • Research and write about exotic destinations and the accessibility gained with supersonic travel.
    • Illustrate how faster air travel opens up a world of adventure and exploration.
  3. Highlight Opportunities and Experiences:
    • Showcase the business, leisure, and lifestyle opportunities that become available with the speed and convenience of supersonic flight.
    • Paint a vivid picture of how this mode of travel enhances the overall experience of life.
  4. Adapt to Various Platforms and Formats:
    • Tailor storytelling approaches for different platforms, including digital content, social media, video scripts, and more.
    • Stay updated on industry trends and incorporate innovative storytelling techniques into your work.
  5. Edit and Revise Content:
    • Review and edit written content to ensure clarity, consistency, and adherence to brand guidelines.
    • Incorporate feedback from team members to refine and improve storytelling elements.
  6. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams:
    • Work closely with our teams to gather insights and collaborate on content that aligns with the company’s vision.
    • Participate in brainstorming sessions to infuse creativity into our projects.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a creative writer with a focus on creating excitement and engagement.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing diverse storytelling capabilities across multiple formats.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for air travel and a knack for bringing the joy of exploration to life through words.

How to Apply: If you are a passionate storyteller eager to create excitement about the future of air travel, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume, cover letter and a link to your portfolio on our website at https://www.spikeaerospace.com/careers/. In your cover letter, share how you would convey the thrill of supersonic flight and the opportunities it presents.

Spike Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

Join us in shaping stories that make air travel an exhilarating and joyful experience!
